name: Caprese Chicken Skillet
ingredients: 1/2 cup plus 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar, divided
4 small boneless, skinless chicken breasts (24 oz)
2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil, divided
1/4 cup tightly packed fresh basil leaves, thinly sliced
why: Chicken-breast one-pan saute: seared cutlets under a balsamic-tomato-mozzarella-basil topping. 419 cal / 47.5g protein / 21g carbs published, in band and squarely low-carb (no rice/pasta/potato). Weigh-and-divide scales cleanly to 14. Every ingredient maps to the board (chicken-breast, balsamic-vinegar, honey, red-onion, garlic, tomatoes, mozzarella=shredded-cheese, fresh-basil, olive-oil, dried-thyme). Cal sits near the 400 floor - some downside drift risk on our own compute.
